description: This module defines a 'BankReconciliationTool' class extending Frappe's Document class, along with several whitelisted functions for handling bank transactions, including retrieving transactions, calculating balances, updating transactions, creating journal entries and payments, reconciling vouchers, and matching associated documents. It appears to be a backend implementation for bank reconciliation functionalities within an ERPNext-based system.

classes.name: BankReconciliationTool
classes.description: A Document subclass serving as the primary handler for bank reconciliation processes, currently without additional methods or properties.

methods.name: get_bank_transactions(bank_account, from_date = None, to_date = None)
methods.description: Retrieves bank transactions for a specified bank account within optional date ranges, filtering for posted transactions with unallocated amounts.

methods.name: get_account_balance(bank_account, till_date)
methods.description: Calculates the account balance as of a specified date by aggregating transaction data and reflecting system-noted amounts.

methods.name: update_bank_transaction(bank_transaction_name, reference_number, party_type=None, party=None)
methods.description: Updates reference number and party details of a specified bank transaction and returns the updated transaction.

methods.name: create_journal_entry_bts( bank_transaction_name, reference_number=None, reference_date=None, posting_date=None, entry_type=None, second_account=None, mode_of_payment=None, party_type=None, party=None, allow_edit=None)
methods.description: Creates a journal entry based on a bank transaction, linking accounts and parties as necessary, with options for allowing edits before insertion.

methods.name: create_payment_entry_bts( bank_transaction_name, reference_number=None, reference_date=None, party_type=None, party=None, posting_date=None, mode_of_payment=None, project=None, cost_center=None, allow_edit=None)
methods.description: Creates a payment entry based on a bank transaction, handling both receipt and payment types, with optional pre-editing.

methods.name: reconcile_vouchers(bank_transaction_name, vouchers)
methods.description: Reconciles a list of vouchers with a bank transaction, allocating amounts and updating the transaction's payment entries accordingly.

methods.name: get_linked_payments(bank_transaction_name, document_types = None)
methods.description: Retrieves all payment documents that correspond to a specific bank transaction, based on matching criteria.

methods.name: check_matching(bank_account, company, transaction, document_types)
methods.description: Finds matching vouchers for a bank transaction across multiple document types, based on amount and account filters.

methods.name: get_queries(bank_account, company, transaction, document_types)
methods.description: Generates SQL queries to find matching documents such as payment entries, journal entries, sales invoices, purchase invoices, and expense claims.

methods.name: get_pe_matching_query(amount_condition, account_from_to, transaction)
methods.description: Constructs SQL for matching payment entries given amount and account direction conditions.

methods.name: get_je_matching_query(amount_condition, transaction)
methods.description: Constructs SQL for matching journal entries based on transaction details.

methods.name: get_si_matching_query(amount_condition)
methods.description: Constructs SQL for matching sales invoices based on customer details.

methods.name: get_pi_matching_query(amount_condition)
methods.description: Constructs SQL for matching purchase invoices based on supplier details.

methods.name: get_ec_matching_query(bank_account, company, amount_condition)
methods.description: Constructs SQL for matching expense claims based on employee and mode of payment.
